_doc: Every environment key a genesis-ceremony phase reads, by class. Kept in step with the scripts by phase_inputs.py check-spec (a tripwire in the genesis-scripts suite and CI); P0 checks the p0/late/unset entries through phase_inputs.py preflight before anything is sent. See phase_inputs.py for the classes.

SIGNER_1.why: InstitutionalVault 2-of-3 signer (DeployEduStack); unset falls back to the deployer and the three must be distinct, which fails P2 after earlier steps broadcast

TREASURY.why: DeployAll's fee recipient (#396); required on 40204 and never the deployer; P2's gate reads it back from the chain

RELAYER.why: the institutional relayer (DeployEduStack); unset falls back to the deployer, which must hold nothing after the handover

CITRATE_AA_OWNER.why: owner of the AA stack (aa/DeployAA requires it, mid-P2)

CITRATE_AA_IDENTITY_SIGNER.why: the deploy-permit signer (aa/DeployAA requires it, mid-P2)

CITRATE_AA_SPONSOR_SIGNER.why: the paymaster sponsorship signer, a separate key from the identity signer (aa/DeployAA, separation of duties)

TREASURY.why: the fee recipient DeployAll sets at construction (X402Facilitator, ModelMarketplace, ComputeMarketplace); never the deployer, and required on 40204

DEPLOYER_ADDRESS.why: the ceremony deployer; P0 checks it and binds it in the run manifest

CEREMONY_DEPLOYER_ADDRESS.why: C9: a preset value must be DEPLOYER_ADDRESS byte for byte; P0 then sets it

RPC_URL.why: the chain; P0 reads chain id and block 0 through it

TEAM_VESTING_FILE.why: the owner's vesting schedule; P0 checks that the file exists, and --confirm requires it

PATRONAGE_KYC_REGISTRY.why: P4 sets it to the library's KYCRegistry (P3L, under GOVERNANCE) from the recorded library book; a preset other value is refused

PATRONAGE_MEMBERSHIP.why: PatronageLedger's coop membership SBT; deployed under GOVERNANCE after P1, so a fresh run checks it at P4 before P4 sends

GOVERNANCE.why: load_governance sets it from P1's recorded output (C2); P2 and the P4L library scripts read it

GUARDIAN.why: load_governance sets it from P1's recorded output (C2)

GOVERNANCE_TIMELOCK.why: load_governance sets it from P1's recorded output (C2)

GOVERNANCE_MULTISIG.why: load_governance sets it from P1's recorded output (C2)

VALIDATOR_REGISTRY.why: regenesis.sh captures it from the DeployValidatorRegistry broadcast

GENESIS_PROFILE.why: P1 always runs the genesis profile

ADDRESS_BOOK.why: P5 hands the checker its merged book

REQUIRE_ALL_CODE.why: P5 always requires code at every book address

CITRATE_AA_DAILY_CAP.why: AA per-wallet daily cap (wei), default 0.01 ether

CITRATE_AA_MAX_FEE_CEIL.why: AA max fee ceiling (wei), default 20 gwei

CITRATE_AA_GLOBAL_CAP.why: AA global daily cap (wei), default 5 ether

CITRATE_AA_ENTRY_POINT.why: the EntryPoint is CREATE2-deployed at its projected address; a pin that differs fails aa/DeployAA mid-P2

P256_VERIFIER_INITCODE.why: the verifier is deployed from the vendored init code; an override that does not produce P256.VERIFIER fails mid-P2

P256_VERIFIER_SALT.why: the verifier is deployed with the vendored salt; an override fails mid-P2

MEMBERSHIP_GRANTOR.why: the treasury-signer address that places membership grants (DeployGenesisMembership, P2's last step); a separate account from the deployer

ALLOW_SHARED_HOLDERS.why: DeployGenesisGovernance refuses it on the genesis profile; a genesis council never shares holders

ALLOW_WEAK_GOVERNANCE.why: DeployGenesisGovernance refuses it on the genesis profile; the genesis floors apply

ALLOW_PAST_VESTING_START.why: DeployTeamVesting refuses a past start unless it is 1; off by default

EXTRA_ADDRESS_BOOKS.why: extra books for the checker; P5 merges every ceremony output into ADDRESS_BOOK itself, so an extra book only adds to the sweep

TIMELOCK_HISTORY_FROM_BLOCK.why: the admin checks scan role history from block 0 of a fresh chain; a later start or a narrower window could miss a grant

TIMELOCK_HISTORY_WINDOW.why: the admin checks scan role history from block 0 of a fresh chain; a later start or a narrower window could miss a grant

GENESIS_CHAIN.why: the admin checks' genesis-chain mode (holder sets from block-0 state) is for a chain whose contracts are in block 0; the ceremony devnet has full role history, which the checks must scan

GENESIS_ALLOC.why: the block-0 allocation for the admin checks' genesis-chain mode; it does not exist until the ceremony's state is dumped, and a stale one must not feed a ceremony check

EXPECTED_IPFS_V3.why: P3L computes it with DeployFederatedLearning.projectIpfsV3(GOVERNANCE, GOVERNANCE) for this run's governance; a preset other value is refused

ROOT_GOVERNANCE.why: P4L sets it to GOVERNANCE (DeployScopedSBTs: FacilitySBT/NetworkSBT governance)

KYC_UPDATER.why: P4L sets it to GOVERNANCE (the KYCRegistry admin, so no extra updater); the deployer must not keep KYC_UPDATER_ROLE

HUP_REGISTRY_ADMIN.why: P4L sets it to GOVERNANCE: OrganizationSBT, AgentSBT and CapsuleRegistry are born owned by it, and no separate CitAgentTimelock is deployed

HUP_BOOK_PATH.why: P4L writes the P2 book plus this run's library so far, for DeployHupRegistries' 40204 ceremony-set check

HUP_MEMBER_SBT.why: P4L sets it from the P2 book's CitrateMemberSBT

TEE_REGISTRY.why: P4L sets it from the P2 book's TEEAttestationRegistry (ComputePoolPipeline)

SBT_MINTER.why: FacilitySBT/NetworkSBT minter defaults to their governance (GOVERNANCE); another minter is an owner decision, not a ceremony override

FOLD_VERIFIER.why: IPFSIncentivesV3 uses the fold-verifier precompile 0x0130; an override moves the reviewed address

HUP_TIMELOCK_OWNER_0.why: HUP_REGISTRY_ADMIN is GOVERNANCE, so no CitAgentTimelock is deployed

HUP_TIMELOCK_OWNER_1.why: HUP_REGISTRY_ADMIN is GOVERNANCE, so no CitAgentTimelock is deployed

HUP_TIMELOCK_OWNER_2.why: HUP_REGISTRY_ADMIN is GOVERNANCE, so no CitAgentTimelock is deployed

HUP_TIMELOCK_DELAY.why: HUP_REGISTRY_ADMIN is GOVERNANCE, so no CitAgentTimelock is deployed

CMO_PORTAL_SEED_E2E.why: dev-only sample data (DeployComplianceRegistry refuses it on 40204)
